name: Romeo and Juliet
source:
You have discovered true love very early in life. You have loved each other unconditionally, strongly, purely. Everybody will try to stand in your way. Are you ready to fight for true love?

[From in-app]
translation:
你们在人生很早的时候便遇见了真爱。你们无条件地爱着彼此，爱得热烈而纯粹。所有人都会试图阻挠你们。你准备好为真爱而战了吗？

[摘自应用内介绍]
